approved_manuscript_text_en: M4 was prespecified but was not admitted to modeling because the available data did not provide adequate coverage and did not satisfy the frozen feature definitions. Consequently, the M4−M3-CBI comparison was not executed, no p-value was computed, and no inferential conclusion is drawn for M4.
approved_manuscript_text_fa: بلوک M4 از پیش تعریف شده بود، اما به‌دلیل ناکافی‌بودن پوشش داده‌ها و برآورده‌نشدن تعاریف تثبیت‌شده ویژگی‌ها، وارد مرحله مدل‌سازی نشد. در نتیجه، مقایسه M4−M3-CBI اجرا نشد، هیچ مقدار p محاسبه نشد و هیچ نتیجه استنباطی درباره M4 ارائه نمی‌شود.
authorized_scope: Governance/reporting recording ONLY of how the never-executed M4-M3-CBI comparison is to be presented in the manuscript. This authorization does NOT cover executing M4, executing the M4 Data Gate, completing or downloading data, materializing any M4 feature, modeling, incremental evaluation, Holm execution, bootstrap, SHAP, final-model selection, refit, Final Test access, Stage130, marking a PR ready, or merging.
human_decision_translation: I approve the manuscript reporting decision: report M4 as a prespecified but unexecuted block, discontinued for data inadequacy. Keep the M4−M3-CBI comparison with status NOT_EXECUTED_M4_DISCONTINUED, with no p-value and no inferential conclusion.
human_decision_verbatim: تصمیم گزارش‌دهی مقاله را تأیید می‌کنم: M4 به‌عنوان بلوک از پیش تعریف‌شده اما اجرا‌نشده، به علت ناکافی‌بودن داده گزارش شود. مقایسه M4−M3-CBI با وضعیت NOT_EXECUTED_M4_DISCONTINUED، بدون p-value و بدون نتیجه استنباطی حفظ شود.
stop_reason_summary: Coverage of the available data was inadequate and the frozen Stage125 feature definitions were not satisfied, so the block was stopped before admission and before any modeling.
why_not_recorded_as_fail_m4_data_gate: The formal M4 Data Gate was never executed and was never executable. No development/fold-level coverage threshold was ever computed and no M4 feature was ever materialized, so the formal verdict stays null. Reporting the block as prespecified-but-not-executed is a presentation decision; recording it as FAIL_M4_DATA_GATE would fabricate a formal evaluation that never happened.
